007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolRunResult;
013
014/** Sample for running a DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT tool. */
015public final class RunToolSample {
016
017    private RunToolSample() {
018    }
019
020    /**
021     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
022     *
023     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
024     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
025     */
026    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
027        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
028        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createSelectAIAgent()) {
029            String inputJson = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_JSON", "{}");
030            ToolRunResult result = selectAIAgent.tool(toolName).run(inputJson);
031            System.out.println(result == null ? "null" : result.getRawValue());
032        }
033    }
034
035    private static SelectAIAgent createSelectAIAgent() throws SelectAIException {
036        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
037                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
038                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
039                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
040                .build());
041    }
042
043    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
044        String value = System.getenv(name);
045        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
046            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
047        }
048        return value;
049    }
050
051    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
052        String value = System.getenv(name);
053        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
054    }
055}
